verified_signals.entity: Croatia - Ministry of Finance / HNB (free basic services package)
verified_signals.signal: Croatia's free-basic-services-package regime (Ministry of Finance Q&A dated 4 veljace 2026 = 04/02/2026) confirms, verbatim: the package must include services enabling cash DEPOSIT to the payment account at a counter OR at an ATM, explicitly excluding coin processing ('osim obrade kovanog novca'); free cash withdrawal at the counter or ATM of the account-holding bank; free internet OR mobile banking at the bank's choice; and free debit-card issuance and use at physical points of sale. From 01/01/2027 a package holder additionally gets two free cash withdrawals per month at OTHER banks' ATMs in Croatia (same right for vulnerable-group basic-account holders). The bank's deadline to act on a customer request falls from 30 days to 10 working days on 02/07/2026. The package is NOT automatic - it applies only on customer request, for one euro account receiving regular income. VERIFIER CAVEAT ON DEMAND SIZE: take-up is so far small - 108,171 packages opened, 1.6% of 5.9 million consumer accounts (tportal, 27/04/2026).
verified_signals.source_name: Ministarstvo financija RH - Pitanja i odgovori (paket besplatnih usluga), PDF
verified_signals.implies: The mechanism is NOT that the law forces ATM deposit - it makes deposit free at the counter OR the ATM, and a bank can technically comply using tellers only. The commercial driver is that free-at-the-counter is the expensive way to comply, so banks are pushed to steer free deposits onto cheaper self-service: deposit ATMs, recyclers, cash-cycle optimisation and branch transformation. The coin carve-out makes coin-deposit machines a chargeable add-on and therefore a saleable product rather than a compliance cost. The 01/01/2027 cross-bank withdrawal right is the bigger structural driver (see the national shared ATM network signal). Size the near-term deposit-migration opportunity off actual take-up (1.6% today), not off the whole retail base.
verified_signals.likelihood: Certain - in force; 02/07/2026 milestone already passed, 01/01/2027 milestone fixed
verified_signals.followup: Obtain the Zakon text and its Narodne novine citation (the Q&A references 'Zakon' without a citation). Track package take-up quarterly - if it stays near 1.6% the deposit-migration case is much weaker than headline. Track deposit-capable ATM additions per bank via HNB PI2 and bank locators since 01/01/2026.
verified_signals.verifier_note: The PDF is a 5-page Croatian document whose Type0 subset fonts defeat naive text extraction (my first two passes silently dropped every digit). I wrote a ToUnicode-CMap decoder handling hex-string show operators and recovered the full 16.6k-character text, then read the relevant answers verbatim. (so 04/02/2026 is right); Q2 'usluge koje omogucuju polaganje gotovog novca na racun za placanje na salteru ili bankomatu, osim obrade kovanog novca'; Q3 'od 1. sijecnja 2027. ostvaruje pravo na dva besplatna podizanja gotovog novca mjesecno na bankomatima drugih banaka u Republici Hrvatskoj'; Q12 'u roku od 30 dana od primitka zahtjeva. I CORRECTED the causal framing in 'implies': the researcher wrote that making ATM deposit free 'pushes deposit volume off the teller onto machines', but the statute makes deposit free at counter OR ATM, so the push is economic (cost of teller compliance), not legal. Also noted the package is request-based, not automatic.

verified_signals.entity: Croatia - national shared ATM network project (HUB / HNB / banks)
verified_signals.signal: [CORRECTED] Croatian banks are negotiating a shared national ATM network as the cost-sharing mechanism for the statutory right, effective 01/01/2027, of free-package holders to make two free monthly withdrawals at any bank's ATM. The Croatian Banking Association (HUB) is on record calling it 'an extremely complex and multi-layered project requiring technical, operational and legal alignment of multiple stakeholders'. Reportedly (tportal states this UNOFFICIALLY, 'nesluzbeno'), Ernst & Young was commissioned to produce a study that yielded three candidate operating models, with a final decision expected 'in a few weeks' from 27/04/2026 - a window that has now passed with no publicly confirmed outcome as of 31/07/2026. FINA was floated as network operator under a model favoured by HNB, with a draft memorandum of understanding prepared, but responsibility was ultimately left to inter-bank agreement. Context from the same article: about 1,000 Croatian ATMs already sit in the existing MBNet shared network, which lets member banks share infrastructure cost; 106 million ATM transactions worth EUR 19.24bn were made in 2024; 3,816 ATMs were active in 2025 with more than 4,700 operational during the summer; retail fees are about EUR 380m, roughly 40% of bank fee and commission income.
verified_signals.source_name: tportal (relaying Poslovni dnevnik for the HUB quote) - 'Sprema se velika promjena na bankomatima: Ceka se samo jedan dogovor'
verified_signals.implies: A pooled national ATM utility remains the single largest Croatian opportunity in this cluster: it needs a multivendor switch/driving layer, shared monitoring, cash forecasting and optimisation, and an outsourced ATM-as-a-service operator - Printec's managed-services proposition. Two corrections change the sales approach. First, the 01/01/2027 free-withdrawal right is unconditional, so the deadline pressure is on how banks share the cost, not on whether the entitlement lands - the pitch is cost-mutualisation, not compliance. Second, MBNet already exists with ~1,000 ATMs, so the realistic route to market is extending or re-platforming an incumbent shared scheme rather than a greenfield build; identify MBNet's operator and switch vendor before pitching.
verified_signals.likelihood: Medium - the statutory entitlement is certain, but the operating model is undecided and the expected decision window (a few weeks from 27/04/2026) has already slipped with no confirmed outcome
verified_signals.followup: PRIORITY: establish who operates MBNet today and on what switch - it is the incumbent to displace or partner with. Obtain the EY study and the three models; check HUB, HNB and Ministry of Finance press pages and Narodne novine for any decision after 27/04/2026 (the researcher's claimed late-May development could not be found and appears not to exist). Confirm whether any operator RFP has been issued.
